items.question: Trong câu "What changes is the RHYTHM: how much you do, when, and where you record it.", từ "rhythm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What changes is the RHYTHM: how much you do, when, and where you record it.", what does "rhythm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rhythm /ˈrɪðəm/ (danh từ): nhịp độ làm việc. "Rhythm" gốc là nhịp điệu âm nhạc; "sprint rhythm" = nhịp làm việc theo sprint.
items.explanationEn: rhythm /ˈrɪðəm/ (noun): a regular working pace. Originally a musical beat; "sprint rhythm" is the repeating cadence of sprints.

items.question: Trong câu "In either model you still have to understand the business problem, identify stakeholders, elicit needs, clarify detail before developers write code, and confirm that what shipped matches what was agreed.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In either model you still have to understand the business problem, identify stakeholders, elicit needs, clarify detail before developers write code, and confirm that what shipped matches what was agreed.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪsɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập. "Elicit needs/requirements" = khơi ra nhu cầu; đừng nhầm với "illicit" (bất hợp pháp).
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪsɪt/ (verb): to draw out from people. "Elicit needs/requirements" means drawing them out; do not confuse it with "illicit" (illegal).

items.question: Trong câu "In either model you still have to understand the business problem, identify stakeholders, elicit needs, clarify detail before developers write code, and confirm that what shipped matches what was agreed.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In either model you still have to understand the business problem, identify stakeholders, elicit needs, clarify detail before developers write code, and confirm that what shipped matches what was agreed.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): được phát hành. Trong phần mềm "ship a feature" = phát hành tính năng tới người dùng; nghĩa gốc là vận chuyển hàng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to be released to users. In software, "ship a feature" means release it to users; the original sense is transporting goods.

items.question: Trong câu "A common mistake when switching models: carrying the old habits over.", từ "carry over" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common mistake when switching models: carrying the old habits over.", what does "carry over" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to bring into a new setting
items.explanation: carry over /ˈkæri ˈoʊvər/ (cụm từ): mang theo sang (chỗ mới). "Carry something over (into)" = mang sang bối cảnh mới; "carry over tasks" = chuyển việc sang sprint sau.
items.explanationEn: carry over /ˈkæri ˈoʊvər/ (phrase): to bring into a new setting. "Carry something over (into)" means bringing it to a new context; unfinished tasks are also "carried over".

items.question: Trong câu "A BA moving from waterfall to Scrum often still tries to specify the entire product before sprint 1 — wasted effort, since most of it will change.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA moving from waterfall to Scrum often still tries to specify the entire product before sprint 1 — wasted effort, since most of it will change.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: specify /ˈspesɪfaɪ/ (động từ): đặc tả chi tiết. Danh từ "specification" (spec); "specify requirements" = đặc tả yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspesɪfaɪ/ (verb): to state in detail. Noun: "specification" (spec); "specify requirements" means stating them precisely.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA moving from waterfall to Scrum often still tries to specify the entire product before sprint 1 — wasted effort, since most of it will change.", từ "effort" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA moving from waterfall to Scrum often still tries to specify the entire product before sprint 1 — wasted effort, since most of it will change.", what does "effort" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: effort /ˈefərt/ (danh từ): công sức. "Wasted effort" = công sức bỏ phí; "make an effort" = cố gắng.
items.explanationEn: effort /ˈefərt/ (noun): work and energy. "Wasted effort" is work that brings no value; "make an effort" means to try.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA moving the other way often records too little, leaving a distant team without enough to build from.", từ "distant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA moving the other way often records too little, leaving a distant team without enough to build from.", what does "distant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distant /ˈdɪstənt/ (tính từ): ở xa (về địa lý). "A distant team" = đội ở xa (khác địa điểm); nghĩa khác "distant manner" = thái độ xa cách.
items.explanationEn: distant /ˈdɪstənt/ (adjective): far away in location. "A distant team" works far away; "a distant manner" means cool and unfriendly.

items.question: Trong câu "Phase 1 — Initiation.", từ "initiation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phase 1 — Initiation.", what does "initiation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: initiation /ɪˌnɪʃiˈeɪʃn/ (danh từ): giai đoạn khởi động. Động từ "initiate" = khởi xướng; "project initiation" = giai đoạn khởi động dự án.
items.explanationEn: initiation /ɪˌnɪʃiˈeɪʃn/ (noun): the starting phase. Verb: "initiate"; "project initiation" is the phase where a project is started.

items.question: Trong câu "Contribute to opportunity and feasibility analysis.", từ "feasibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Contribute to opportunity and feasibility analysis.", what does "feasibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feasibility /ˌfiːzəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): tính khả thi. Tính từ "feasible" = khả thi; "feasibility study" = nghiên cứu khả thi.
items.explanationEn: feasibility /ˌfiːzəˈbɪləti/ (noun): how doable it is. Adjective: "feasible"; a "feasibility study" checks whether a project can realistically be done.

items.question: Trong câu "Help define the business objectives, preliminary scope, and stakeholders.", từ "objective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Help define the business objectives, preliminary scope, and stakeholders.", what does "objective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: objective /əbˈdʒektɪv/ (danh từ): mục tiêu. Danh từ "objective" = mục tiêu; tính từ "objective" = khách quan (trái nghĩa "subjective").
items.explanationEn: objective /əbˈdʒektɪv/ (noun): a goal. As a noun it means a goal; as an adjective it means unbiased (opposite "subjective").

items.question: Trong câu "Help define the business objectives, preliminary scope, and stakeholders.", từ "preliminary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Help define the business objectives, preliminary scope, and stakeholders.", what does "preliminary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: preliminary /prɪˈlɪmɪneri/ (tính từ): sơ bộ, ban đầu. "Preliminary scope/results" = phạm vi/kết quả sơ bộ, sẽ được chi tiết hóa sau.
items.explanationEn: preliminary /prɪˈlɪmɪneri/ (adjective): initial, not final. "Preliminary scope/results" are early versions to be refined later.

items.question: Trong câu "Running reviews, obtaining approval, and then baselining the document.", từ "obtain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Running reviews, obtaining approval, and then baselining the document.", what does "obtain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: obtain /əbˈteɪn/ (động từ): có được. "Obtain approval/permission" = xin được phê duyệt/sự cho phép; trang trọng hơn "get".
items.explanationEn: obtain /əbˈteɪn/ (verb): to get or gain. "Obtain approval/permission" means getting it; a more formal word than "get".

items.question: Trong câu "Running reviews, obtaining approval, and then baselining the document.", từ "baseline" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Running reviews, obtaining approval, and then baselining the document.", what does "baseline" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (động từ): chốt bản chuẩn. "Baseline a document" = chốt phiên bản làm mốc; thay đổi sau đó phải qua quy trình kiểm soát thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪslaɪn/ (verb): to freeze a reference version. "Baseline a document" freezes a reference version; later changes go through change control.

items.question: Trong câu "Phase 4 — Development. Answering developer questions, processing change requests through the change control process, updating documentation and the traceability matrix.", từ "traceability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phase 4 — Development. Answering developer questions, processing change requests through the change control process, updating documentation and the traceability matrix.", what does "traceability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traceability /ˌtreɪsəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): khả năng truy vết. "Traceability matrix" = ma trận truy vết, liên kết mỗi yêu cầu với thiết kế và test case.
items.explanationEn: traceability /ˌtreɪsəˈbɪləti/ (noun): ability to trace links. A "traceability matrix" links each requirement to its design and test cases.

items.question: Trong câu "Phase 5 — Testing. Reviewing test cases for requirement coverage, helping classify whether a defect is a code fault or a missing requirement.", từ "coverage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phase 5 — Testing. Reviewing test cases for requirement coverage, helping classify whether a defect is a code fault or a missing requirement.", what does "coverage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: coverage /ˈkʌvərɪdʒ/ (danh từ): độ bao phủ. "Test/requirement coverage" = mức độ test bao phủ yêu cầu; "media coverage" = sự đưa tin.
items.explanationEn: coverage /ˈkʌvərɪdʒ/ (noun): the extent covered. "Test/requirement coverage" is how much is covered by tests; "media coverage" is news reporting.

items.question: Trong câu "Phase 5 — Testing. Reviewing test cases for requirement coverage, helping classify whether a defect is a code fault or a missing requirement.", từ "classify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phase 5 — Testing. Reviewing test cases for requirement coverage, helping classify whether a defect is a code fault or a missing requirement.", what does "classify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: classify /ˈklæsɪfaɪ/ (động từ): phân loại. Danh từ "classification"; "classified" còn có nghĩa là tài liệu mật.
items.explanationEn: classify /ˈklæsɪfaɪ/ (verb): to sort into types. Noun: "classification"; "classified" can also mean secret, as in classified documents.

items.question: Trong câu "Phase 5 — Testing. Reviewing test cases for requirement coverage, helping classify whether a defect is a code fault or a missing requirement.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phase 5 — Testing. Reviewing test cases for requirement coverage, helping classify whether a defect is a code fault or a missing requirement.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Defect" gần nghĩa "bug"; động từ "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ = đào ngũ, bỏ phe. "Code fault" = lỗi trong code.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (noun): a flaw or bug. "Defect" is close to "bug"; the verb /dɪˈfekt/ means to desert. A "code fault" is an error in the code.

items.question: Trong câu "Phase 6 — Deployment and acceptance. Running UAT, preparing user documentation, training users, supporting sign-off.", từ "sign-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Phase 6 — Deployment and acceptance. Running UAT, preparing user documentation, training users, supporting sign-off.", what does "sign-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sign-off /ˈsaɪn ɔːf/ (danh từ): sự ký duyệt chính thức. Danh từ "sign-off" = chấp thuận chính thức; cụm động từ "sign off on something" = ký duyệt.
items.explanationEn: sign-off /ˈsaɪn ɔːf/ (noun): formal written approval. The noun "sign-off" is formal approval; the phrasal verb is "sign off on something".

items.question: Trong câu "The BA's biggest risk in waterfall: locking everything down too early.", từ "lock down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA's biggest risk in waterfall: locking everything down too early.", what does "lock down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lock down /lɑːk daʊn/ (cụm từ): chốt cứng lại. "Lock down the requirements" = chốt cứng yêu cầu; danh từ "lockdown" = phong tỏa.
items.explanationEn: lock down /lɑːk daʊn/ (phrase): to freeze firmly. "Lock down the requirements" means freezing them; the noun "lockdown" means sealing off an area.

items.question: Trong câu "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", từ "uncertain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", what does "uncertain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uncertain /ʌnˈsɜːrtn/ (tính từ): chưa chắc chắn. Danh từ "uncertainty"; khi yêu cầu chưa chắc chắn, nên làm prototype thay vì viết tài liệu dài.
items.explanationEn: uncertain /ʌnˈsɜːrtn/ (adjective): not yet known for sure. Noun: "uncertainty"; when requirements are uncertain, prototype instead of writing long specs.

items.question: Trong câu "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", từ "prototype" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", what does "prototype" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prototype /ˈproʊtətaɪp/ (danh từ): bản mẫu thử nghiệm. "Build a prototype" = làm bản mẫu để thử ý tưởng nhanh, rẻ trước khi xây thật.
items.explanationEn: prototype /ˈproʊtətaɪp/ (noun): an early trial model. "Build a prototype" to test an idea quickly and cheaply before building it for real.

items.question: Trong câu "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", từ "incremental" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", what does "incremental" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incremental /ˌɪŋkrəˈmentl/ (tính từ): tăng dần từng phần. "Incremental delivery" = bàn giao từng phần nhỏ; danh từ "increment" = phần tăng thêm.
items.explanationEn: incremental /ˌɪŋkrəˈmentl/ (adjective): in small added steps. "Incremental delivery" ships small pieces over time; noun: "increment".

items.question: Trong câu "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", từ "guesswork" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where requirements are still uncertain, use prototypes and incremental delivery to reduce risk rather than writing a 200-page SRS on guesswork.", what does "guesswork" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guesswork /ˈɡeswɜːrk/ (danh từ): sự phỏng đoán. "Based on guesswork" = dựa trên phỏng đoán, không có dữ liệu thực tế.
items.explanationEn: guesswork /ˈɡeswɜːrk/ (noun): guessing, not facts. "Based on guesswork" means built on guesses rather than facts.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice the BA work still exists, and somebody must do it.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice the BA work still exists, and somebody must do it.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (cụm từ): trên thực tế. "In practice" = trên thực tế, đối lập với "in theory" (trên lý thuyết).
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (phrase): in reality. "In practice" means in reality, as opposed to "in theory".

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog refinement (grooming) — the most important event for a BA:", từ "refinement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog refinement (grooming) — the most important event for a BA:", what does "refinement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (danh từ): sự tinh chỉnh. Động từ "refine" = tinh chỉnh; "backlog refinement" = làm rõ, chia nhỏ, ước lượng các mục backlog.
items.explanationEn: refinement /rɪˈfaɪnmənt/ (noun): gradual improvement. Verb: "refine"; "backlog refinement" means clarifying, splitting and estimating backlog items.

items.question: Trong câu "Backlog refinement (grooming) — the most important event for a BA:", từ "grooming" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backlog refinement (grooming) — the most important event for a BA:", what does "grooming" (noun) mean?
options: việc chuẩn bị, sắp xếp backlog
items.explanation: grooming /ˈɡruːmɪŋ/ (danh từ): việc chuẩn bị, sắp xếp backlog. Tên cũ của backlog refinement; nghĩa đời thường là chải chuốt, chăm sóc ngoại hình.
items.explanationEn: grooming /ˈɡruːmɪŋ/ (noun): tidying and preparing a backlog. An older name for backlog refinement; in everyday use it means caring for appearance.

items.question: Trong câu "Surfacing hidden work: empty states, error states, permissions, data migration.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Surfacing hidden work: empty states, error states, permissions, data migration.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːrfɪs/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, đưa lên. Động từ "surface an issue" = đưa vấn đề ra ánh sáng; danh từ "surface" = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːrfɪs/ (verb): to bring into view. "Surface an issue" means bringing it into view; the noun "surface" is the outside layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Surfacing hidden work: empty states, error states, permissions, data migration.", từ "migration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Surfacing hidden work: empty states, error states, permissions, data migration.", what does "migration" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: moving data to a new system
items.explanation: migration /maɪˈɡreɪʃn/ (danh từ): việc chuyển đổi dữ liệu. "Data migration" = chuyển dữ liệu từ hệ thống cũ sang mới, thường là khối việc ẩn.
items.explanationEn: migration /maɪˈɡreɪʃn/ (noun): moving data to a new system. "Data migration" moves data from an old system to a new one, often hidden work.

items.question: Trong câu "Sprint planning — explaining stories, answering questions so the team can estimate accurately, confirming the definition of ready.", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sprint planning — explaining stories, answering questions so the team can estimate accurately, confirming the definition of ready.", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈestɪmeɪt/ (động từ): ước lượng. Động từ /ˈestɪmeɪt/, danh từ /ˈestɪmət/; "estimate effort" = ước lượng công sức.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈestɪmeɪt/ (verb): to judge roughly. Verb /ˈestɪmeɪt/, noun /ˈestɪmət/; teams "estimate effort" for each story.

items.question: Trong câu "Daily scrum — listening for blockers; many turn out to be unclear requirements the BA can resolve the same day.", từ "blocker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Daily scrum — listening for blockers; many turn out to be unclear requirements the BA can resolve the same day.", what does "blocker" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: blocker /ˈblɑːkər/ (danh từ): trở ngại cản tiến độ. "Blocker" là việc khiến người khác không làm tiếp được; "be blocked" = bị chặn.
items.explanationEn: blocker /ˈblɑːkər/ (noun): an obstacle stopping work. A "blocker" is anything that stops someone from continuing; "be blocked" is the state.

items.question: Trong câu "Daily scrum — listening for blockers; many turn out to be unclear requirements the BA can resolve the same day.", từ "turn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Daily scrum — listening for blockers; many turn out to be unclear requirements the BA can resolve the same day.", what does "turn out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: turn out /tɜːrn aʊt/ (cụm từ): hóa ra là. "Turn out to be" = hóa ra là; nghĩa khác "turn out the lights" = tắt đèn.
items.explanationEn: turn out /tɜːrn aʊt/ (phrase): to prove to be. "Turn out to be" means prove to be in the end; "turn out the lights" means switch them off.

items.question: Trong câu "Daily scrum — listening for blockers; many turn out to be unclear requirements the BA can resolve the same day.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Daily scrum — listening for blockers; many turn out to be unclear requirements the BA can resolve the same day.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɑːlv/ (động từ): giải quyết. "Resolve an issue" = giải quyết vấn đề; "resolve to do" = quyết tâm làm.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɑːlv/ (verb): to settle a problem. "Resolve an issue" means settle it; "resolve to do something" means decide firmly.

items.question: Trong câu "During the sprint — the biggest time sink nobody talks about: answering questions continuously, clarifying when testers find ambiguity, preparing stories for the next sprint.", từ "time sink" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "During the sprint — the biggest time sink nobody talks about: answering questions continuously, clarifying when testers find ambiguity, preparing stories for the next sprint.", what does "time sink" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: time sink /taɪm sɪŋk/ (cụm từ): việc ngốn thời gian. "Time sink" = việc âm thầm tiêu tốn nhiều thời gian; "sink" gốc là bồn rửa, nơi mọi thứ chảy vào.
items.explanationEn: time sink /taɪm sɪŋk/ (phrase): a drain on time. A "time sink" quietly consumes lots of time; a "sink" is where things drain away.

items.question: Trong câu "Sprint retrospective — participating as a team member; if many defects trace back to unclear requirements, that is a process problem to fix.", từ "retrospective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sprint retrospective — participating as a team member; if many defects trace back to unclear requirements, that is a process problem to fix.", what does "retrospective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: retrospective /ˌretrəˈspektɪv/ (danh từ): buổi họp nhìn lại. Viết tắt "retro"; nhóm nhìn lại sprint để cải tiến. Nghĩa khác: triển lãm hồi cố của nghệ sĩ.
items.explanationEn: retrospective /ˌretrəˈspektɪv/ (noun): a meeting to look back. Often shortened to "retro"; the team reviews the sprint to improve. Also an exhibition of an artist's past work.

items.question: Trong câu "Sprint retrospective — participating as a team member; if many defects trace back to unclear requirements, that is a process problem to fix.", từ "participate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sprint retrospective — participating as a team member; if many defects trace back to unclear requirements, that is a process problem to fix.", what does "participate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: participate /pɑːrˈtɪsɪpeɪt/ (động từ): tham gia. "Participate in something" = tham gia vào việc gì; danh từ "participant".
items.explanationEn: participate /pɑːrˈtɪsɪpeɪt/ (verb): to take part. "Participate in something" means take part; noun: "participant".

items.question: Trong câu "Sprint retrospective — participating as a team member; if many defects trace back to unclear requirements, that is a process problem to fix.", từ "trace back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sprint retrospective — participating as a team member; if many defects trace back to unclear requirements, that is a process problem to fix.", what does "trace back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: trace back /treɪs bæk/ (cụm từ): bắt nguồn từ. "Trace back to X" = có nguồn gốc từ X; lỗi truy về yêu cầu mơ hồ là vấn đề quy trình.
items.explanationEn: trace back /treɪs bæk/ (phrase): to originate from. "Trace back to X" means have X as the origin; defects traced to unclear requirements signal a process issue.

items.question: Trong câu "The golden rule for a BA in Scrum: always keep about TWO to THREE sprints of work in a ready state.", từ "golden rule" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The golden rule for a BA in Scrum: always keep about TWO to THREE sprints of work in a ready state.", what does "golden rule" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: golden rule /ˈɡoʊldən ruːl/ (cụm từ): nguyên tắc vàng. "The golden rule" = nguyên tắc quan trọng nhất cần luôn tuân theo.
items.explanationEn: golden rule /ˈɡoʊldən ruːl/ (phrase): the most important principle. "The golden rule" is the key principle you should always follow.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most confusing question when an organization adopts Scrum.", từ "adopt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most confusing question when an organization adopts Scrum.", what does "adopt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adopt /əˈdɑːpt/ (động từ): áp dụng. "Adopt a framework" = áp dụng một phương pháp; đừng nhầm với "adapt" (điều chỉnh cho phù hợp).
items.explanationEn: adopt /əˈdɑːpt/ (verb): to start using. "Adopt a framework" means start using it; do not confuse it with "adapt" (adjust).

items.question: Trong câu "Accepting or rejecting completed work", từ "reject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Accepting or rejecting completed work", what does "reject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (động từ): từ chối, bác bỏ. Trái nghĩa "accept"; danh từ "rejection". PO có quyền chấp nhận hoặc từ chối việc đã làm.
items.explanationEn: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (verb): to turn down. Opposite of "accept"; noun: "rejection". The PO accepts or rejects completed work.

items.question: Trong câu "Suits simple products and small teams.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Suits simple products and small teams.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "Suit something/someone" = phù hợp với; danh từ "suit" = bộ com-lê, "lawsuit" = vụ kiện.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "Suit something/someone" means be appropriate for it; the noun is a set of clothes, and a "lawsuit" is a court case.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: the PO is overloaded and has no time for both strategy and detail.", từ "overload" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: the PO is overloaded and has no time for both strategy and detail.", what does "overload" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overload /ˌoʊvərˈloʊd/ (động từ): làm quá tải. "Be overloaded (with work)" = quá tải công việc; trong lập trình "method overloading" là khái niệm khác.
items.explanationEn: overload /ˌoʊvərˈloʊd/ (verb): to overburden. "Be overloaded (with work)" means having too much; "method overloading" in programming is a separate idea.

items.question: Trong câu "3. The BA acts as proxy PO.", từ "proxy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "3. The BA acts as proxy PO.", what does "proxy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: proxy /ˈprɑːksi/ (danh từ): người đại diện, thay mặt. "Proxy PO" = người thay mặt PO; trong mạng máy tính "proxy server" = máy chủ trung gian.
items.explanationEn: proxy /ˈprɑːksi/ (noun): someone acting for another. A "proxy PO" acts on the PO's behalf; in networking a "proxy server" is an intermediary.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA stands in for the PO in daily work with the team.", từ "stand in for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA stands in for the PO in daily work with the team.", what does "stand in for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: stand in for /stænd ɪn fɔːr/ (cụm từ): làm thay, thay thế tạm. "Stand in for someone" = làm thay ai; danh từ "stand-in" = người thay thế.
items.explanationEn: stand in for /stænd ɪn fɔːr/ (phrase): to substitute for. "Stand in for someone" means replacing them temporarily; noun: "stand-in".

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: without real decision authority, the team is still blocked.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: without real decision authority, the team is still blocked.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /əˈθɔːrəti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "Decision authority" = quyền ra quyết định; "the authorities" = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /əˈθɔːrəti/ (noun): the power to decide. "Decision authority" is the power to decide; "the authorities" are officials.

items.question: Trong câu "What matters is not the job title but this: ONE person must be able to decide order and value, and that person must be available when the team needs them.", từ "available" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What matters is not the job title but this: ONE person must be able to decide order and value, and that person must be available when the team needs them.", what does "available" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: available /əˈveɪləbl/ (tính từ): sẵn sàng, có mặt. "Be available" = rảnh, liên lạc được; danh từ "availability" (cũng là "tính sẵn sàng" của hệ thống).
items.explanationEn: available /əˈveɪləbl/ (adjective): reachable. "Be available" means free and reachable; noun: "availability", also a system quality.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most contested point when moving from waterfall to Scrum.", từ "contested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most contested point when moving from waterfall to Scrum.", what does "contested" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contested /kənˈtestɪd/ (tính từ): gây tranh cãi. Động từ "contest" = tranh cãi, phản đối; "a contested issue" = vấn đề gây tranh cãi.
items.explanationEn: contested /kənˈtestɪd/ (adjective): disputed. Verb: "contest" (to dispute); "a contested issue" is one people argue about.

items.question: Trong câu "Does this knowledge need to outlive the team's memory?", từ "outlive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does this knowledge need to outlive the team's memory?", what does "outlive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (động từ): tồn tại lâu hơn. Tiền tố "out-" = hơn; "outlive" = sống/tồn tại lâu hơn. Quy tắc nghiệp vụ tồn tại lâu hơn mọi dự án.
items.explanationEn: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (verb): to last longer than. The prefix "out-" means "more than"; business rules outlive every project.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there a compliance, audit, or contractual requirement?", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there a compliance, audit, or contractual requirement?", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ. "Compliance requirement" = yêu cầu tuân thủ (luật, chuẩn ngành); tính từ "compliant".
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪəns/ (noun): obeying rules. A "compliance requirement" comes from laws or standards; adjective: "compliant".

items.question: Trong câu "Is there a compliance, audit, or contractual requirement?", từ "audit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there a compliance, audit, or contractual requirement?", what does "audit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: audit /ˈɔːdɪt/ (danh từ): sự kiểm toán. "Audit trail" = dấu vết kiểm toán; đừng nhầm với "audition" (thử giọng).
items.explanationEn: audit /ˈɔːdɪt/ (noun): an official inspection. An "audit trail" records who did what; do not confuse it with "audition".

items.question: Trong câu "Is there a compliance, audit, or contractual requirement?", từ "contractual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there a compliance, audit, or contractual requirement?", what does "contractual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contractual /kənˈtræktʃuəl/ (tính từ): theo hợp đồng. Gốc "contract" (hợp đồng); "contractual obligation" = nghĩa vụ theo hợp đồng.
items.explanationEn: contractual /kənˈtræktʃuəl/ (adjective): contract-based. From "contract"; a "contractual obligation" is one a contract imposes.

items.question: Trong câu "Is the team distributed across locations or time zones?", từ "distributed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is the team distributed across locations or time zones?", what does "distributed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (tính từ): phân tán (nhiều nơi). "Distributed team" = đội làm việc ở nhiều nơi; "distributed system" = hệ thống phân tán.
items.explanationEn: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (adjective): spread across places. A "distributed team" works from several places; compare "distributed system".

items.question: Trong câu "Is the cost of recording less than the cost of rediscovering?", từ "rediscover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is the cost of recording less than the cost of rediscovering?", what does "rediscover" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find for the first time
items.explanation: rediscover /ˌriːdɪˈskʌvər/ (động từ): tìm hiểu lại từ đầu. Tiền tố "re-" = lại; nếu không ghi lại, đội sau phải tốn công tìm hiểu lại.
items.explanationEn: rediscover /ˌriːdɪˈskʌvər/ (verb): to find out again. The prefix "re-" means again; unrecorded knowledge must be rediscovered at a cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Things almost always worth recording, even in Scrum:", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Things almost always worth recording, even in Scrum:", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːrθ/ (tính từ): đáng để (làm gì). "Worth + V-ing" = đáng làm; "worth it" = đáng công.
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːrθ/ (adjective): deserving of. "Worth + -ing" means it deserves doing; "worth it" means the effort pays off.

items.question: Trong câu "Data definitions and the glossary — they prevent integration defects.", từ "glossary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data definitions and the glossary — they prevent integration defects.", what does "glossary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: glossary /ˈɡlɑːsəri/ (danh từ): bảng thuật ngữ. "Glossary" giúp mọi người dùng chung một nghĩa cho thuật ngữ nghiệp vụ.
items.explanationEn: glossary /ˈɡlɑːsəri/ (noun): a list of terms. A glossary makes everyone use business terms with the same meaning.

items.question: Trong câu "Architectural decisions with their rationale — future maintainers will need them.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architectural decisions with their rationale — future maintainers will need them.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnæl/ (danh từ): lý do, cơ sở. "The rationale for/behind a decision" = lý do đằng sau quyết định; khác "rational" (hợp lý).
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnæl/ (noun): the reasons behind. "The rationale for/behind a decision" is its reasoning; different from "rational" (sensible).

items.question: Trong câu "Architectural decisions with their rationale — future maintainers will need them.", từ "maintainer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architectural decisions with their rationale — future maintainers will need them.", what does "maintainer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: maintainer /meɪnˈteɪnər/ (danh từ): người bảo trì. Gốc "maintain" = duy trì, bảo trì; maintainer tương lai cần biết lý do của các quyết định kiến trúc.
items.explanationEn: maintainer /meɪnˈteɪnər/ (noun): a system upkeeper. From "maintain"; future maintainers need to know why architectural choices were made.

items.question: Trong câu "Automated acceptance tests — the only documentation that never goes stale, because it runs.", từ "go stale" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Automated acceptance tests — the only documentation that never goes stale, because it runs.", what does "go stale" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go stale /ɡoʊ steɪl/ (cụm từ): trở nên lỗi thời. "Stale" gốc là ôi, cũ (stale bread); tài liệu "go stale" khi không còn khớp với hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: go stale /ɡoʊ steɪl/ (phrase): to become outdated. "Stale" originally describes old bread; documents "go stale" when they no longer match the system.

items.question: Trong câu "The real risk is not producing less documentation but confusing less documentation with less thinking.", từ "confuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The real risk is not producing less documentation but confusing less documentation with less thinking.", what does "confuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (động từ): nhầm lẫn. "Confuse A with B" = nhầm A với B; nghĩa khác "the instructions confused me" = làm tôi rối.
items.explanationEn: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (verb): to mistake for. "Confuse A with B" means mistake one for the other; "it confused me" means it bewildered me.

items.question: Trong câu "Healthy agile teams still invest heavily in understanding the problem — they simply do not package it into 200 pages.", từ "package" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Healthy agile teams still invest heavily in understanding the problem — they simply do not package it into 200 pages.", what does "package" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to present in a set form
items.explanation: package /ˈpækɪdʒ/ (động từ): trình bày thành. "Package X into Y" = trình bày X dưới dạng Y; danh từ "package" = gói hàng, gói phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: package /ˈpækɪdʒ/ (verb): to present in a set form. "Package X into Y" means presenting X in that form; the noun is a parcel or software package.

items.question: Trong câu "Many BAs in Vietnam are in the middle of this transition.", từ "transition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many BAs in Vietnam are in the middle of this transition.", what does "transition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: transition /trænˈzɪʃn/ (danh từ): giai đoạn chuyển đổi. "In transition" = đang chuyển đổi; trong CSS/slide "transition" là hiệu ứng chuyển cảnh.
items.explanationEn: transition /trænˈzɪʃn/ (noun): a changeover. "In transition" means changing over; in CSS or slides it is an animation effect.

items.question: Trong câu "Here are the practical adjustments:", từ "adjustment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here are the practical adjustments:", what does "adjustment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: adjustment /əˈdʒʌstmənt/ (danh từ): sự điều chỉnh. Động từ "adjust"; "make adjustments" = điều chỉnh cho phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: adjustment /əˈdʒʌstmənt/ (noun): a small change. Verb: "adjust"; "make adjustments" means changing things to fit better.

items.question: Trong câu "Waiting for a signed-off document before letting the team begin.", từ "signed-off" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Waiting for a signed-off document before letting the team begin.", what does "signed-off" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: signed-off /saɪnd ˈɔːf/ (tính từ): đã được ký duyệt. "A signed-off document" = tài liệu đã được ký duyệt; chờ nó mới bắt đầu là thói quen nên bỏ trong Agile.
items.explanationEn: signed-off /saɪnd ˈɔːf/ (adjective): approved. "A signed-off document" has formal approval; waiting for one before starting is a habit to drop in Agile.

items.question: Trong câu "Treating requirement change as a failure of the analysis phase.", từ "treat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Treating requirement change as a failure of the analysis phase.", what does "treat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: treat /triːt/ (động từ): coi (như là). "Treat X as Y" = coi X là Y; nghĩa khác "treat a patient" = chữa bệnh, "my treat" = tôi mời.
items.explanationEn: treat /triːt/ (verb): to regard as. "Treat X as Y" means regard X as Y; other senses: "treat a patient", "it's my treat".

items.question: Trong câu "Splitting epics into stories as vertical slices rather than by technical layer.", từ "vertical slice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Splitting epics into stories as vertical slices rather than by technical layer.", what does "vertical slice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: vertical slice /ˈvɜːrtɪkl slaɪs/ (cụm từ): lát cắt dọc. "Vertical slice" = story xuyên qua mọi tầng (UI, logic, data) và mang lại giá trị dùng được.
items.explanationEn: vertical slice /ˈvɜːrtɪkl slaɪs/ (phrase): a thin end-to-end feature. A "vertical slice" cuts through every layer (UI, logic, data) to deliver usable value.

items.question: Trong câu "Hybrid models are very common in Vietnam:", từ "hybrid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hybrid models are very common in Vietnam:", what does "hybrid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hybrid /ˈhaɪbrɪd/ (tính từ): lai, kết hợp. "Hybrid model" = mô hình lai; cũng gặp trong "hybrid car", "hybrid work".
items.explanationEn: hybrid /ˈhaɪbrɪd/ (adjective): mixed, combined. A "hybrid model" mixes approaches; also seen in "hybrid car" and "hybrid work".

items.question: Trong câu "the contract and overall scope run waterfall so the customer can sign, while delivery inside runs Scrum.", từ "overall" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the contract and overall scope run waterfall so the customer can sign, while delivery inside runs Scrum.", what does "overall" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overall /ˌoʊvərˈɔːl/ (tính từ): tổng thể. "Overall scope" = phạm vi tổng thể; danh từ "overalls" = quần yếm (khác nghĩa).
items.explanationEn: overall /ˌoʊvərˈɔːl/ (adjective): taken as a whole. "Overall scope" is the scope as a whole; "overalls" is an unrelated clothing word.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA in this setup does both: maintaining the high-level document for the contract and a detailed backlog for the team.", từ "maintain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA in this setup does both: maintaining the high-level document for the contract and a detailed backlog for the team.", what does "maintain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì. "Maintain a document" = duy trì, cập nhật tài liệu; "maintain that..." = khẳng định rằng.
items.explanationEn: maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep up to date. "Maintain a document" means keep it current; "maintain that..." means insist.

items.question: Trong câu "A BA in this setup does both: maintaining the high-level document for the contract and a detailed backlog for the team.", từ "high-level" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A BA in this setup does both: maintaining the high-level document for the contract and a detailed backlog for the team.", what does "high-level" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: high-level /ˌhaɪ ˈlevl/ (tính từ): tổng quan, khái quát. "High-level document" = tài liệu mức tổng quan; trái nghĩa "low-level/detailed".
items.explanationEn: high-level /ˌhaɪ ˈlevl/ (adjective): broad, without detail. A "high-level document" gives the broad picture; the opposite is "detailed" or "low-level".

items.question: Trong câu "The analysis work is the same in both models; the rhythm, detail level, and storage differ.", từ "storage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The analysis work is the same in both models; the rhythm, detail level, and storage differ.", what does "storage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: storage /ˈstɔːrɪdʒ/ (danh từ): nơi lưu giữ. Ở đây là nơi lưu kết quả phân tích (SRS hay backlog); nghĩa kỹ thuật là bộ nhớ lưu trữ.
items.explanationEn: storage /ˈstɔːrɪdʒ/ (noun): where it is kept. Here it is where analysis lives (an SRS or backlog); technically it also means disk capacity.

items.question: Trong câu "In waterfall, the BA's value concentrates in the analysis phase and in maintaining documentation through change.", từ "concentrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In waterfall, the BA's value concentrates in the analysis phase and in maintaining documentation through change.", what does "concentrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: concentrate /ˈkɑːnsntreɪt/ (động từ): tập trung vào. "Concentrate in" = dồn vào một chỗ; "concentrate on" = tập trung chú ý vào.
items.explanationEn: concentrate /ˈkɑːnsntreɪt/ (verb): to gather in one place. "Concentrate in" means be gathered in one place; "concentrate on" means focus attention.

items.question: Trong câu "In Scrum, the BA's value lies in grooming, continuous clarification, and holding the big picture while the team focuses story by story.", từ "lie in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Scrum, the BA's value lies in grooming, continuous clarification, and holding the big picture while the team focuses story by story.", what does "lie in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lie in /laɪ ɪn/ (cụm từ): nằm ở, nằm trong. "X lies in Y" = X nằm ở Y; "have a lie-in" (Anh) = ngủ nướng.
items.explanationEn: lie in /laɪ ɪn/ (phrase): to be found in. "X lies in Y" means X is found in Y; in British English "a lie-in" is sleeping late.

items.question: Trong câu "In Scrum, the BA's value lies in grooming, continuous clarification, and holding the big picture while the team focuses story by story.", từ "the big picture" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Scrum, the BA's value lies in grooming, continuous clarification, and holding the big picture while the team focuses story by story.", what does "the big picture" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: the big picture /ðə bɪɡ ˈpɪktʃər/ (cụm từ): bức tranh tổng thể. "See/hold the big picture" = nắm được toàn cảnh trong khi nhóm tập trung vào từng story.
items.explanationEn: the big picture /ðə bɪɡ ˈpɪktʃər/ (phrase): the overall view. "See/hold the big picture" means keeping the overall view while the team works story by story.

items.question: Trong câu "The documentation level should be decided by five pragmatic questions, not by either model's dogma.", từ "pragmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The documentation level should be decided by five pragmatic questions, not by either model's dogma.", what does "pragmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pragmatic /præɡˈmætɪk/ (tính từ): thực dụng, thiết thực. "Pragmatic approach" = cách tiếp cận thực tế; danh từ "pragmatism".
items.explanationEn: pragmatic /præɡˈmætɪk/ (adjective): practical, realistic. A "pragmatic approach" focuses on what works; noun: "pragmatism".

items.question: Trong câu "The documentation level should be decided by five pragmatic questions, not by either model's dogma.", từ "dogma" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The documentation level should be decided by five pragmatic questions, not by either model's dogma.", what does "dogma" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dogma /ˈdɔːɡmə/ (danh từ): giáo điều. Tính từ "dogmatic" = giáo điều; áp dụng mô hình máy móc là dogma.
items.explanationEn: dogma /ˈdɔːɡmə/ (noun): rigid beliefs. Adjective: "dogmatic"; applying a model mechanically is dogma.
